adds.title: Georgian Ombudsman call April 2018 citing Oliari and Others v. Italy + European Convention on Human Rights
adds.summary: Georgia's Public Defender 2017 report issued 2 April 2018 established that prosecutors examined 86 alleged hate crimes in 2017 including 37 based on gender identity, that violence in family and public spaces remained a serious unaddressed problem with transgender women in particular appealing about violence faced, that numerous complaints concerned homophobic attitudes by law enforcement with complainants withdrawing for lack of belief in timely investigation, and that law enforcement had no efficient strategy against hate-motivated violence and reacted only to individual cases.
